<!-- pr-reviewer: ed7df993ff839d42ec88618a7227f420890e5ebc -->
**Review @ ed7df993 (M5; M3 wrote the PR): clean, `merge-ready`.** I read the diff. It is one test file (+7/-7).

- The helper `beside_the_cut_part` expected a `Gouge` from the stock-source pocket. PR #1656 (#1554) makes the stock-source region equal to the stock footprint minus the parts in the step-down ladder. Thus the pocket now stays off the part. The new assert requires that no `Gouge` occurs. This is a stronger check than before, not a weaker one. If the pocket cuts the part again, this test fails.
- The helper now returns all warnings. Before, it filtered out the `Gouge` lines. No warning can hide because the assert removes the only filtered kind.
- There is no production code, no golden and no process file in the diff. The author reports 6/6 tests pass and clean clippy. Changelog is none (test-only). This is correct.

Note: a release is in progress. If the red `lead_approach` stops the cut's release gate, the maintainer can apply this change in the cut.
